name: IX Australia Content Network
notes:
AS10084 is an auxiliary content distribution network that compliments IX Australia's exchanges with various caches; from Netflix (OCA), Meta (MNA), Steam (STM), Microsoft (MCC) and more.

AS10084 will also originate prefixes for various networks we deem appropriate for the exchange who no longer peer (AS15169).

To control access to these content services, we aim to ensure all content is opt-in by default to bring as much traffic to your peering ports; however, some may require explicit opt-in. Please review the CDN policy control section to configure your visibility from AS10084’s perspective at https://ix.asn.au/technical-guide/
